title: Treat pre-existing review findings as advisory
body:
Judges keep flagging defects that exist on the base (PR #112, #114 overrides). Mark a finding pre-existing when its cited lines are outside the diff or unchanged since the base, record it as advisory, and never let it block. Pattern from the Claude Code team code-review write-up (Important / Nit / Pre-existing).
Acceptance: a finding on an untouched line is recorded as pre-existing and does not fail the panel; a finding on a changed line still blocks; tests cover both and moved lines.
